== Trivia ==
* Started playing League in 2017.
* Was originally a jungle and ADC main but switched to ADC main fully because of [[Ruler]] winning [[Worlds 2017]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jckTXpl6qT0 FNC Noah "We BEAT Asian Teams in scrims!!" Is G2 stronger than FNC? | Worlds 2023] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* When asked who his role model was in [[KT Rolster Academy]], he said that his role model is [[Ruler]] and continues to be a fan of him.
